title: The Traffic Fine
intro: A text says you owe a traffic fine. It wants you to install an app to pay.
Tap anything that looks odd to sniff it closer. Pin what is suspicious, clear what is harmless.
When you are sure, decide what to do.

notify.text: Pending traffic fine. Install the app to pay…

screen.context: You have not had any traffic fine recently.

msg.text: Pay today or your driving licence will be suspended.

fine.label: A fine you do not know of
fine.lens: You have no recent traffic offence.
fine.why: A fine out of nowhere deserves a check, not a payment.

suspend.label: Threat to suspend
suspend.lens: Pay today or lose your licence.
suspend.why: A threat with a deadline is a pressure trick.

link.label: An app file and a look-alike site
link.lens: The link ends in ".apk" and is not an official address.
link.why: Official offices do not ask you to install an app from a link.

sender.label: An official-looking name
sender.why: Sender names are easy to type.

notice.label: A fine number
notice.why: Numbers are easy to invent. Check on the official portal.

actions.label: Check for fines on the official traffic website I type myself

trap.title: Install unknown app?
trap.ask: This app wants to read your messages and show over other apps. Install?

block_report.line: Reported and deleted. Your phone company can block the next one.

verify.line: The official traffic website showed no fine on your vehicle. The text was fake. Case cracked.

ignore.line: You stayed safe. But the same scam is still landing on other people.

go_ahead.line: The app read your messages and codes, then emptied your account while you waited for a receipt.

what_if.go_ahead: Checking the official site would have shown no fine. A real office never asks you to install an app from a link.
what_if.ignore: Reporting takes two taps and helps protect other people.
what_if.verify: Checking was smart. Reporting it as well helps protect other people.

golden_rule: A fine is paid on an official website you type yourself. Never install an app from a text.

quick_check.q: A text says you owe a traffic fine and must install an app to pay. What is the best move?

options.text: Install the app but do not log in
Check on the official website you type yourself, and report the text
Reply to ask if it is real

quick_check.explain: Fines are not paid through apps from texts. Check on the official site.

hints.nudge: What kind of file is that link, and who asks you to install it?

rows.v: A short code, no phone number
Do not ask you to install apps
